price_outcomes.meaning: Exact subsequent calendar-month price observations alongside revised macro measurements. The macro observation month is not the time its data became available. These are retrospective outcomes, not an executable backtest, forecast probability or net return.

research_index.formula: For one common closed reference month, transform four level series using exact-calendar YoY. Standardize all seven against the preceding 60 calendar months excluding the target, sample standard deviation, at least 48 numeric months and a full returned span. Sum exact z-scores times the declared legacy weights; do not renormalize missing components.
research_index.meaning: Descriptive relative macro indicator. Not GDP growth, a recession probability, an identified economic regime or an investment signal.
research_index.weight_origin: Fixed predecessor judgmental weights, not estimated GDP coefficients or validated investment weights.
